categories.name: build
categories.evidence: Matches the 'Build system' label and adds patches to the capnp package in depends.
categories.rationale: Backports upstream Cap'n Proto patches to depends to prevent false-positive TSan data race failures in unoptimized builds. While it fixes CI job failures impacting libmultiprocess#376, it affects debug assertion reads rather than release binaries or core platform build breakage.
